title: Has anyone else seen the offshore ruins?
content: One of the motifs that have always stuck with me is the idea of these ruins off in the distance. Sometimes I’m on a ship of some kind and I see these moss covered ruins off in the distance. The second level of the first sonic game will give you a good example of how they appear. I never enter them or even get close to them, but there is a vague feeling of wrongness with them. I feel this wrongness in other places, usually dealing with religion of some sort. Come to think of it, it’s the feeling I get when I’m in the strange bathrooms when I have a dream inside The School.
